The test image shows the **underside (abaxial surface)** of a soybean leaf covered with numerous small, raised, tan-to-reddish-brown **pustules (uredinia)** scattered uniformly across the leaf surface. There are also a few insect feeding holes.

The reference image for Soybean_rust confirms the match — the top-right close-up panel shows exactly this same pattern: densely scattered tan/brown uredinia on the lower leaf surface, identical to the test image.

This is clearly distinct from Cercospora (angular brown spots), Bacterial_Blight (water-soaked lesions with yellow halos), or Downy_mildew (grayish fuzzy growth). The raised pustule morphology on the abaxial surface is the hallmark of soybean rust.
